label: Game A
nuance_found: Build and upgrade choices (ballista vs pickle cannon splash vs mustard slow, tomato/cheese upgrades), a burner flame ability, and a SWAT tap. Stage 1 was won with no trouble; on stage 2 hoarding coins lost me the game twice (wave 9 and the wave 10 JAR boss), so spending early mattered. One obvious best line otherwise.
audio: Looping music per stage, a victory sting and boss music, plus thwip, pop, place, cannon and wave-ding effects; music dropped out for stretches in the first minutes.
furthest_progress: Stage 1 The Cutting Board cleared with 3 stars (score 12,950, 20/20 lives); Stage 2 The Stovetop reached wave 10/10 and the JAR boss, lost with score 23,000 (best); second attempt lost at wave 9; third attempt at wave 6 when I stopped.
control_trouble: Build-menu card taps occasionally missed after the camera moved; my blind multi-tap scripts sometimes did not build. The game was not at fault.
best_moment: Stage 1 win screen with three stars and combo x16, and the big combo counters in wave 8.
worst_moment: Losing the final JAR boss wave after a long easy stretch, with lots of idle waiting and a slow 1x start.
verdict: Pretty and clear: tap a plate, pick a weapon, start the wave, and the olives pop with satisfying thwips and combo numbers. Stage 1 was too easy, so I mostly sat and watched. Stage 2 got my attention when the boss jar ate my lunch, and I wanted one more try. A lot of the time is waiting for waves to walk down the path, which is slow for a bus ride, but it is a game I would give a second go.
